substantiveCommits.message: qa: define benchmark primitive exposure contract
qa: gate visible stock primitives in benchmark framing
qa: lock primitive gate to capture view source
qa: bind primitive exposure gate to capture view lock
qa: enforce benchmark primitive exposure before 4k render

focus: Geometry & construction fidelity / critical visible primitive-placeholder risk

implementation.policy: Project every actively rendered Unity stock solid Cube/Cylinder/Sphere/Capsule under QualityBlock1990s into the locked 3840x2160 hero, oblique and grazing camera framing. Fail before reflection/capture work if a projected stock solid is visibly significant by the hard screen-space thresholds or spans the camera plane. Plane/Quad are not automatically classified because thin physical/decal/foliage carriers may legitimately be planar; their actual appearance remains render-review evidence.
implementation.captureBinding: The gate duplicates the deterministic view values only after config QA proves QualityBlock4KCapture.cs still contains the exact locked 3840x2160 camera positions, targets and FOV values. Any capture-framing drift therefore fails closed instead of silently weakening primitive screening.

verification.type: GitHub source/static inspection only; no Unity runtime was available
verification.branchComparison: Start head to substantive work head is ahead by 5 and behind by 0. All writes in this run were confined to UnityProject/Assets/Editor or UnityProject/Assets/QA; Godot was not modified and no base merge was performed.
verification.captureSourceInspection: QualityBlock4KCapture still defines native 3840x2160 hero, oblique and grazing views at the exact positions/targets/FOV locked by the new contract.
verification.runnerState: GitHub Actions workflow runs for gpt/unity-migration remain 0; substantive head commit status contexts remain 0.
verification.renderEvidenceState: Assets/QA/Captures4K is absent from the current repository tree. No actual Unity-rendered pixels, primitive runtime report, 100% crops or temporal sequence were produced or reviewed.

implementationReadiness.reason: The new screen-space critical-risk gate improves evidence readiness but cannot replace the missing Unity 6000.3.0f1 compile/runtime verification weighted by the existing readiness model.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Geometry & construction fidelity (20): prevents authoritative evidence generation while a large active Unity stock solid survives in the exact benchmark framing; expected to expose overlooked placeholder meshes that curated name-based structural refinement can miss.
Critical-defect integrity: visible primitive-placeholder geometry remains automatic FAIL, and a source-side empty violation list still cannot clear it without native 4K pixel inspection.

Workflow efficiency: source projection preflight runs before realtime reflection rendering, and is rechecked immediately before still capture and again before temporal work, so expensive evidence generation does not proceed from a known placeholder-risk scene.
correctivePolicyIfRuntimeFails: Do not weaken thresholds or add name-based exemptions. Use the runtime report's hierarchy path, mesh name, benchmark view and pixel footprint to identify the exposed assembly; reconstruct its real manufacture/installation with dimensioned physical geometry or authored art, preserve mounting/interfaces/material metadata and LOD policy, then rerun the same gate.
nextBlocker: Unity 6000.3.0f1 editor/runner compile and execution. At first availability, run Prepare Complete Native 4K Review Packet. If benchmark_primitive_exposure_runtime_report.json reports any violations, stop before speculative expansion and replace the largest projected stock-solid assembly first. Only after the source gate passes should reflection synchronization and real hero/oblique/grazing 3840x2160 evidence proceed; Visual Fidelity scoring must then use the actual pixels and 100% crops.
